subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• Malia Kealoha (born 1987) is a composer and sound designer from Canada.
• She is best known for the science fiction podcast series Stellar Drift.
• Stellar Drift premiered in 2018 on AudioVerse, a platform that Kealoha co-founded.
• The series was praised for its immersive soundscapes and innovative narrative structure.
• Stellar Drift was nominated for a Hugo Award for Best Dramatic Presentation.
prompt: The student wants to begin a narrative about Kealoha's award-nominated podcast series. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: Stellar Drift was praised for its immersive soundscapes and innovative narrative structure, and it was nominated for a Hugo Award for Best Dramatic Presentation.
choices.B: Kealoha, co-founder of the platform AudioVerse, would go on to see her podcast series be nominated for a Hugo Award.
choices.C: In 2018, Stellar Drift premiered on AudioVerse; it would later be nominated for an award.
choices.D: In 2018, composer and sound designer Malia Kealoha launched a new science fiction podcast series: Stellar Drift.

explanation:
Choice D is correct. It introduces Kealoha and Stellar Drift to an unfamiliar audience by specifying the time period and genre of the podcast series.

Why A is incorrect:

Choice A is incorrect. This choice isn't suited for beginning a narrative. A narrative is a story that follows a sequence of events and creates interest and suspense for the reader. This choice jumps to the end, explaining the success of Stellar Drift without explaining what it is.
